mcp_tools.name: append_only_ledger_design_audit
mcp_tools.title: Append only ledger design audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit a ledger-design evidence manifest; get a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict on append-only ledger invariants (no mutation paths, compensating-entry corrections, integrity, reconciliation, recovery) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The ledger-design evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

money.description: Money representation evidence (integer minor units, double entry).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid; satisfies all 29 checks.
